method: Actual full-browser CDP JPEG frames to H264 VFR; absolute original timestamps quantized to1ms BEFORE deriving duration differences, preventing accumulated rounding drift; option framerate1000 provides1ms input timebase; explicit encoder/container1/1000; no fps filter, interpolation, duplication, dropped frames or speed changes. Original canvas VP9 independently retained, a different simultaneous capture stream, NOT asserted to have same frame count as CDP.
timelineOrder: All original frames sorted by their unchanged CDP capture timestamps, not delivery order. Original delivery list retained in capture.json.

nativeCanvas.durationNote: Original MediaRecorder WebM has no container duration metadata; decoded first/last presentation timestamps measured directly, average uses (frames-1)/(last-first)

rawJPEGRetention: Ignored execution cache only; every original source frame timestamp/hash is checkpointed in capture.json, both encoded video artifacts are checkpointed.

runtimeDuringCapture.scope: During simultaneous native canvas recording and real browser screencast, ending BEFORE recorder stop/serialization. Independent benchmark excludes capture work.
